name: Iterative Story Refinement
description: Cyclical workflow for refining and evolving a story DAG through multiple iterations. Supports adding/removing/modifying nodes with impact analysis.
entry_requirements: Existing story DAG (from NA-01 through NA-05)
Specific change request (add character, modify plot point, etc.)

phases.name: Change Identification
phases.description: Identify what change the author wants to make

llm_prompts.prompt:
The author wants to make a change to their story. Based on their request, identify:
1. What TYPE of change is this? (add_node, remove_node, modify_node, add_subplot, etc.)
2. What specific elements are affected? (node IDs, characters, chapters)
3. What is the author's intent behind this change?
4. Are there any ambiguities that need clarification?

Author's request: {author_request}
Current DAG summary: {dag_summary}

phases.name: Impact Preview
phases.description: Preview the impact of the change before applying it

llm_prompts.prompt:
Analyze this impact report and explain to the author:
1. What will break or change if they proceed
2. What ripple effects will occur
3. Whether this is a safe change or risky
4. Recommendations for proceeding

Impact Report:
{impact_report}

Provide a clear, non-technical explanation.

phases.name: Apply Change
phases.description: Apply the change with full tracking

phases.name: Coherence Validation
phases.description: Validate the DAG is still coherent after changes

phases.name: Fix Issues
phases.description: Address any issues found during validation

phases.name: Finalize Iteration
phases.description: Complete this iteration and prepare for next
